title: HVT escort of sealed 'mystery boxes' on classified flights

tellings.quote: these targets most of the time were like sealed containers. Um, we called them mystery boxes.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he flew helicopters on secret missions, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about work he says he did in the 1990s. He says he escorted what were called high-value targets on classified flights, and that most of the time these were sealed containers his team called "mystery boxes." He tells it because, if true, it would mean the government was quietly moving cargo so secret that even the people guarding it were not told what was inside.
